==Norwegian Bokmål==

[[Image:C-major a-minor.svg|250px|thumb|A-minor.]]

===Etymology===
{{root|nb|ine-pro|*(s)mel-}}
{{prefix|nb|a|moll}}, first part is the first letter of the Norwegian alphabet. Last part from {{bor|nb|de|Moll||minor}}, from {{der|nb|la-med|molle}}, of {{der|nb|la|mollis||soft}}, from earlier {{m|la||*molduis}}, from {{der|nb|itc-pro|*moldus}}, from {{der|nb|ine-pro|*ml̥dus||soft, weak}}, from {{der|nb|ine-pro|*mel-||soft, weak, tender}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|nb|/ɑː.mɔl/}}
* {{audio|nb|nb-a-moll.ogg}}
* {{rhymes|nb|ɔl}}
* {{hyph|nb|a-|moll}}

===Noun===
{{nb-noun-m1}}

# {{lb|nb|music}} [[A minor]] {{q|the minor key with A as its tonic, consisting of the pitches A, B, C, D, E, F, and G}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1957|author=w:Axel Jensen|title=Ikaros|page=84|passage=nordmenn utenfor Norges grenser får tårer i øynene når de hører a-moll av Grieg|t=Norwegians outside Norway's borders get tears in their eyes when they hear A minor by Grieg}}
